Looks good, one nit on the **retry loop**:

> Retries up to five times

Cap the delay at `30 s` so a dead endpoint doesn't hold the queue. See [the docs](https://example.com/retries).

```js
const delay = Math.min(30000, base * 2 ** n);
```
